prompt: Write a list of 12 musical groups, and for each musical group, write the year range in which they performed. Do not write any explanations.
judge_reasoning: Prompt: "Write a list of 12 musical groups, and for each musical group, write the year range in which they performed. Do not write any explanations." Perception scan: last marker found [4]; N=4. Candidate [1] and [4] both provide 12 bands (no obvious solo-artist mismatches) and follow the no-explanations format; [1] has the more consistently plausible “active”/“present” ranges, while [4] includes more likely under-ranges (e.g., Guns N' Roses 1985–1991) and some questionable end dates (e.g., Fleetwood Mac 1967–2018). Candidates [2] and [3] are far weaker because they include solo performers (Michael Jackson, Beyoncé) and [3] also misspells/uses a likely incorrect name (“Garth Brook”), violating the “musical groups/bands” intent.
